343: /// Parse a `sync-collection` REPORT body into its sync token and level.
344: ///
345: /// The `sync-token` element is optional: an absent or empty token requests an
346: /// initial snapshot. The `sync-level` element must be present and equal to 1
347: /// for calendar sync; any other value is rejected.
348: pub fn parse_sync_collection(body: &[u8]) -> Result<SyncCollection, QueryError> {
349:     if body.len() > MAX_BODY_BYTES {
350:         return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
351:     }
352:     let text = std::str::from_utf8(body).map_err(|_| QueryError::MalformedXml)?;
353:     let mut reader = Reader::from_str(text);
354:     reader.config_mut().trim_text(true);
355: 
356:     let mut buf = Vec::new();
357:     let mut root_seen = false;
358:     let mut depth: u32 = 0;
359:     let mut sync_token: Option<String> = None;
360:     let mut sync_level: Option<u32> = None;
361:     let mut capturing: Option<&'static str> = None;
362:     let mut current = String::new();
363: 
364:     loop {
365:         match reader.read_event_into(&mut buf) {
366:             Ok(Event::Start(ref start)) => {
367:                 let local_name_ref = start.local_name();
368:                 let local = name_to_str(local_name_ref.as_ref());
369:                 if !root_seen {
370:                     if local != "sync-collection" {
371:                         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
372:                     }
373:                     root_seen = true;
374:                     depth = 1;
375:                     continue;
376:                 }
377:                 depth += 1;
378:                 if depth == 2 {
379:                     if local == "sync-token" {
380:                         capturing = Some("token");
381:                         current.clear();
382:                     } else if local == "sync-level" {
383:                         capturing = Some("level");
384:                         current.clear();
385:                     }
386:                 }
387:             }
388:             Ok(Event::Empty(ref empty)) => {
389:                 let local_name_ref = empty.local_name();
390:                 let local = name_to_str(local_name_ref.as_ref());
391:                 if !root_seen {
392:                     if local != "sync-collection" {
393:                         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
394:                     }
395:                     root_seen = true;
396:                     continue;
397:                 }
398:                 depth += 1;
399:                 if depth == 2 && local == "sync-token" {
400:                     // Self-closing sync-token carries no text: initial snapshot.
401:                     sync_token = Some(String::new());
402:                 }
403:                 depth = depth.saturating_sub(1);
404:             }
405:             Ok(Event::Text(ref text_event)) => {
406:                 if capturing.is_some() {
407:                     current.push_str(text_event.unescape().unwrap_or_default().as_ref());
408:                 }
409:             }
410:             Ok(Event::End(_)) => {
411:                 if let Some(kind) = capturing {
412:                     capturing = None;
413:                     let value = current.trim().to_owned();
414:                     match kind {
415:                         "token" => {
416:                             sync_token = Some(value);
417:                         }
418:                         "level" => {
419:                             sync_level = value.parse::<u32>().ok();
420:                         }
421:                         _ => {}
422:                     }
423:                 }
424:                 depth = depth.saturating_sub(1);
425:             }
426:             Ok(Event::Eof) => {
427:                 if depth > 0 {
428:                     return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
429:                 }
430:                 break;
431:             }
432:             Ok(_) => {}
433:             Err(_) => return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml),
434:         }
435:         buf.clear();
436:     }
437: 
438:     if !root_seen {
439:         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
440:     }
441:     let level = sync_level.ok_or(QueryError::BadSyncLevel)?;
442:     if level != 1 {
443:         return Err(QueryError::BadSyncLevel);
444:     }
445:     let token = sync_token.unwrap_or_default();
446:     Ok(SyncCollection {
447:         sync_token: if token.is_empty() { None } else { Some(token) },
448:         sync_level: level,
449:     })
450: }

452: /// Determine the report type from the body and parse it accordingly.
453: pub fn parse_calendar_report(body: &[u8]) -> Result<CalendarReport, QueryError> {
454:     if body.len() > MAX_BODY_BYTES {
455:         return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
456:     }
457:     let text = std::str::from_utf8(body).map_err(|_| QueryError::MalformedXml)?;
458:     let root = peek_root(text).ok_or(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot)?;
459:     match root.as_str() {
460:         "calendar-query" => Ok(CalendarReport::Query(parse_calendar_query(body)?)),
461:         "calendar-multiget" => Ok(CalendarReport::Multiget(parse_calendar_multiget(body)?)),
462:         "sync-collection" => Ok(CalendarReport::SyncCollection(parse_sync_collection(body)?)),
463:         _ => Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot),
464:     }
465: }

467: /// Read the first element name in an XML document, if any.
468: fn peek_root(text: &str) -> Option<String> {
469:     let mut reader = Reader::from_str(text);
470:     reader.config_mut().trim_text(true);
471:     let mut buf = Vec::new();
472:     loop {
473:         match reader.read_event_into(&mut buf) {
474:             Ok(Event::Start(ref start)) => {
475:                 return Some(name_to_str(start.local_name().as_ref()).to_owned());
476:             }
477:             Ok(Event::Empty(ref empty)) => {
478:                 return Some(name_to_str(empty.local_name().as_ref()).to_owned());
479:             }
480:             Ok(Event::Eof) => return None,
481:             Ok(_) => {}
482:             Err(_) => return None,
483:         }
484:         buf.clear();
485:     }
486: }

254:     /// matched against their calendar dates (the range endpoints are converted
255:     /// to UTC dates), so a query window that touches a day includes the
256:     /// all-day events spanning that day. Recurring events are included when
257:     /// their series start is before the range end (a safe superset: the
258:     /// caller serializes the full series and the client filters occurrences).
259:     pub async fn list_events_in_range(
260:         &self,
261:         calendar_id: i64,
262:         start_utc: i64,
263:         end_utc: i64,
264:         limit: usize,
265:     ) -> Result<Vec<i64>, CaldavAuthError> {
266:         let start_date = utc_date(start_utc);
267:         let end_date = utc_date(end_utc);
268:         let ids: Vec<i64> = sqlx::query_scalar(
269:             "SELECT id FROM events
270:               WHERE calendar_id = ?
271:                 AND (
272:                      (
273:                          recurrence_rule IS NULL
274:                          AND (
275:                               (
276:                                   event_kind = 'timed'
277:                                   AND timed_start_utc < ?
278:                                   AND timed_end_utc > ?
279:                               )
280:                               OR
281:                               (
282:                                   event_kind = 'all_day'
283:                                   AND all_day_start_date < ?
284:                                   AND all_day_end_date > ?
285:                               )
286:                          )
287:                      )
288:                      OR
289:                      (
290:                          recurrence_rule IS NOT NULL
291:                          AND (
292:                               (event_kind = 'timed' AND timed_start_utc < ?)
293:                               OR
294:                               (event_kind = 'all_day' AND all_day_start_date < ?)
295:                          )
296:                      )
297:                  )
298:               ORDER BY id
299:               LIMIT ?",
300:         )
301:         .bind(calendar_id)
302:         .bind(end_utc)
303:         .bind(start_utc)
304:         .bind(&end_date)
305:         .bind(&start_date)
306:         .bind(end_utc)
307:         .bind(&end_date)
308:         .bind(limit as i64)
309:         .fetch_all(&self.pool)
310:         .await
311:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
312:         Ok(ids)
313:     }
314: 
315:     /// Read the ordered change log for one calendar, starting after the given
316:     /// revision. Returns changes with `id > after_revision` in ascending
317:     /// revision order, bounded by `limit`. This is the ordered change-log
318:     /// input that sync-token paging (T11) builds on.
319:     pub async fn list_changes_since(
320:         &self,
321:         calendar_id: i64,
322:         after_revision: i64,
323:         limit: usize,
324:     ) -> Result<Vec<CaldavEventChange>, CaldavAuthError> {
325:         let rows: Vec<ChangeRow> = sqlx::query_as(
326:             "SELECT id, calendar_id, event_id, change_type, created_at, resource_name
327:               FROM caldav_event_changes
328:               WHERE calendar_id = ? AND id > ?
329:               ORDER BY id
330:               LIMIT ?",
331:         )
332:         .bind(calendar_id)
333:         .bind(after_revision)
334:         .bind(limit as i64)
335:         .fetch_all(&self.pool)
336:         .await
337:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
338:         Ok(rows
339:             .into_iter()
340:             .map(
341:                 |(id, calendar_id, event_id, change_type, created_at, resource_name)| {
342:                     CaldavEventChange {
343:                         id,
344:                         calendar_id,
345:                         event_id,
346:                         change_type,
347:                         created_at,
348:                         resource_name,
349:                     }
350:                 },
351:             )
352:             .collect())
353:     }
354: 
355:     /// Stamp the DAV resource name onto the most recent change-log entry for a
356:     /// calendar. Used by the DAV delete path, where the tombstone is applied
357:     /// before the domain delete records the change, so the name cannot be
358:     /// resolved from the live mapping at record time.
359:     pub async fn stamp_change_resource_name(
360:         &self,
361:         calendar_id: i64,
362:         event_id: i64,
363:         resource_name: &str,
364:     ) -> Result<(), CaldavAuthError> {
365:         sqlx::query(
366:             "UPDATE caldav_event_changes
367:                  SET resource_name = ?
368:                WHERE calendar_id = ? AND event_id = ? AND change_type = 'deleted'
369:                  AND resource_name IS NULL",
370:         )
371:         .bind(resource_name)
372:         .bind(calendar_id)
373:         .bind(event_id)
374:         .execute(&self.pool)
375:         .await
376:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
377:         Ok(())
378:     }
379: 
380:     /// Return the highest change-log revision for a calendar, or 0 when the
381:     /// calendar has no recorded changes. Used to mint the initial snapshot
382:     /// sync token.
383:     pub async fn latest_revision(&self, calendar_id: i64) -> Result<i64, CaldavAuthError> {
384:         let revision: Option<i64> =
385:             sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT MAX(id) FROM caldav_event_changes WHERE calendar_id = ?")
386:                 .bind(calendar_id)
387:                 .fetch_one(&self.pool)
388:                 .await
389:                 .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
390:         Ok(revision.unwrap_or(0))
391:     }

393:     /// Replace the allowlisted client properties for an event (T16). The
394:     /// incoming value is the source of truth: an empty value clears all
395:     /// preserved metadata. The row is upserted so both first-time writes and
396:     /// updates (including explicit removals) are handled uniformly.
397:     pub async fn save_client_properties(
398:         &self,
399:         event_id: i64,
400:         properties: &CaldavClientProperties,
401:         now: i64,
402:     ) -> Result<(), CaldavAuthError> {
403:         let json = serde_json::to_string(properties)
404:             .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
405:         sqlx::query(
406:             "INSERT INTO caldav_event_properties (event_id, properties_json, updated_at)
407:              VALUES (?, ?, ?)
408:              ON CONFLICT(event_id) DO UPDATE SET
409:                 properties_json = excluded.properties_json,
410:                 updated_at = excluded.updated_at",
411:         )
412:         .bind(event_id)
413:         .bind(&json)
414:         .bind(now)
415:         .execute(&self.pool)
416:         .await
417:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
418:         Ok(())
419:     }
420: 
421:     /// Load the allowlisted client properties for an event, or `None` when no
422:     /// metadata has been preserved.
423:     pub async fn load_client_properties(
424:         &self,
425:         event_id: i64,
426:     ) -> Result<Option<CaldavClientProperties>, CaldavAuthError> {
427:         let row: Option<String> = sqlx::query_scalar(
428:             "SELECT properties_json FROM caldav_event_properties WHERE event_id = ?",
429:         )
430:         .bind(event_id)
431:         .fetch_optional(&self.pool)
432:         .await
433:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
434:         let Some(json) = row else {
435:             return Ok(None);
436:         };
437:         let properties: CaldavClientProperties = serde_json::from_str(&json)
438:             .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
439:         Ok(Some(properties))
